sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Straightforward DPS check with a repeating sleep/breakbar cycle and a poison-mushroom floor to manage.

sections.heading: Tantrum & breakbar
bullets: At 80/60/40/20/10% health Slothasor falls asleep (Narcolepsy) — break his defiance bar to wake him back up and keep DPS going.
Tantrum: he pounds the ground 3 times in a row, each hit knocking down anyone caught in it. Dodge each pound, don't just dodge the first.

sections.heading: Poison mushrooms
bullets: Purple mushroom patches on the ground stack poison fast — don't stand in them.
Someone can eat an Imbued Mushroom to turn into a Slubling and clear a poisoned patch by eating it — but Slublings read as hostile to the rest of the squad, so call it out.
The Slubling transform only lasts ~45s, then you're Nauseated and can't transform again for 4 minutes — don't waste it.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: No enrage timer listed — this fight is a soft check, not a hard wall.
